summary: Tyra Biosciences filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement under the ATM program, amending its sales agreement with TD Cowen to increase available common stock offering capacity from $150 million to $250 million. The filing is a routine at-the-market offering document, not a special-situations event, as it involves no premium, tender, merger, or structural change. The supplementary disclosure updates the existing ATM prospectus and outlines ongoing share sales at prevailing market prices. Risk-arb angle: none; this is a standard capital-raising vehicle, with watch on dilution and market reception.
